commits.message: Prepend comments state the table's bounds; test titles name code points (rich-control-codes-xh4n.7cz review)
Prepend lookup takes a code point; the table's test pins both cross-version Prepends and skips unassigned code points (rich-control-codes-xh4n.7cz review)
The Prepend table is the union from the Node floor's Unicode through the pinned one, so the cut is the same on every Node; the data module answers the lookup (rich-control-codes-xh4n.7cz review)
isPrepend reads a vendored Prepend table at the pinned Unicode version, not the engine's segmenter (rich-control-codes-xh4n.7cz)

A Prepend character is its own cluster, and sealed writes a word joiner after it so a clustering terminal agrees (rich-control-codes-xh4n.qmw) (#571)
